preconditions.description: The length of the string s and the length of the string t are between 1 and 2 * 10^5.

preconditions.expression: s consists of lowercase Latin letters and at most one wildcard character '*'.
preconditions.description: The string s can contain at most one wildcard character '*'.

preconditions.expression: t consists only of lowercase Latin letters.
preconditions.description: The string t contains only lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' if t matches s after replacing the wildcard '*' with a sequence of lowercase Latin letters, or 'NO' if it does not match.
